note: wisdom psalm; two ways (righteous/wicked). Characteristics=inner delight/meditation + moral-character nouns + God's knowing. Qualifiers=moral movement (walk/stand/sit), spheres (counsel/way/seat), object (law), extent (day/night), outcomes (yield/wither/prosper/drive/perish/judgment/congregation). Standalone=tree-simile imagery + agents + connectives. NB wind=ruach here is literal WIND (chaff), not spirit.
